@graph.howPerformed: Before treatment, avoid waxing or plucking for at least 4 weeks, and shave the area 24 hours before your appointment. Avoid sun exposure and tanning for 2 weeks beforehand. After treatment, avoid hot showers or saunas for 24 hours, apply sunscreen to the treated areas, and use gentle skincare to soothe any temporary redness.

acceptedAnswer.text: It offers long-term hair reduction, but some maintenance treatments may be needed over time.
Typically, 6–8 sessions are needed for optimal results, depending on your hair type and the area treated.
Most people feel mild discomfort, often described as a snapping sensation. Built-in cooling and numbing creams help keep you comfortable.
Temporary redness, swelling or mild irritation can occur and usually subsides within a few hours. Avoid direct sun and strenuous exercise for a day or two.
